verifiers_at_closure.note: phase1 passes. phase2 and, through it, phase3 fail on two clauses of phase2.pipeline_contract that assert the PRE-EXECUTION state rather than the contract: assert_analysis_refuses_incomplete, which requires the real analysis to refuse and so cannot survive a complete matrix, and e10.assert_no_scientific_cells, which requires zero scientific artefacts. Every other clause of all three phases passes when called individually. This is the same class of state-coupling defect the independent Phase-3 review found in the always-refuses invariant; the analogous execution-aware repair was never applied here. No source was modified to make these pass.
